question_text: A 60-year-old man has had intermittent pain in his right great toe for the past 2 years. Joint aspiration and crystal analysis shows thin, tapered, needle shaped intracellular crystals that are strongly negatively birefringent. Radiograph demonstrates joint space narrowing of the 1st metatarsophalangeal (MTP) joint with medial soft tissue swelling. What is the most likely cause of this condition?
